Eli (Billing): CloudPartner reported missing March payout; their statement shows $11,350 due but our partner statements list $0 for their reseller_id.
gcp-billing-bot: export gcp_billing_2028_03_05.csv processed at 2028-03-06T04:02:10Z.
Rita (Partner Ops): Quick check: March export has ~93 lines where reseller_id IS NULL for sku RWINF-HOST. Looks like the attribution tag failing in the pipeline on 2028-03-05.
Eli (Billing): Can we do provisional payout to avoid partner escalation? We'll need approval from Revenue.
Jon (Revenue): Provisional payout OK if <= $15k and we flag as contra-revenue pending reconciliation. Send CSV and note.
Rita (Partner Ops): Uploaded CSV: https://redwood.app/sheets/gcp-missing-attrib -> sheet "cloudpartner-march". I will open GCP support case and ask about remapping options.
Eli (Billing): I'll book a payable and prepare the payout once Jon confirms accounting treatment. Please track partner sign-off.
Rita (Partner Ops): Partner wants funds ASAP, ETA for provisional payout is 2 business days after ack form.
Jon (Revenue): Proceed with provisional payout and contra-revenue. Keep ledger entries clear.
Eli (Billing): Thanks team — marking P1 and will update when payment scheduled.
